about_the_game:
Welcome to KeyKeeper, a turn-based roguelike adventure that demands both strategic thinking and tactical prowess. In this unique world, every action is governed by action points. Players must carefully allocate these points to attack, defend, or maneuver, crafting their strategy to overcome a diverse range of enemies. Each encounter is a test of wit and determination, challenging players to think ahead and plan each move with precision.



Leveling up in KeyKeeper goes beyond mere numerical increases. Each new level unlocks powerful combat abilities and enhances your character's stats. This progression system is intricately linked with the gameplay, rewarding exploration and engagement with the environment. As players advance, they grow stronger, gaining access to a wider array of spells and skills, each adding a new dimension to combat.



What sets KeyKeeper apart is its innovative equipment system. Equipment found or won in the game not only bolsters your stats but can also dramatically change your combat style. This feature adds a depth of customization, ensuring a unique experience with each playthrough. The game's core mechanic revolves around a limited supply of keys. Running out of keys means the next door opened will trigger a boss battle, blending strategic macroscopic planning with microscopic strategic actions.

content_descriptors.notes: Please note that in this game, players may encounter scenarios where they need to defend themselves against threatening animals such as rats and bats. Additionally, some of the consumable items in the game are references to alcoholic beverages.

name: Keykeeper
short_description: Keykeeper is an enthralling turn-based tactical roguelike, enriched with RPG elements. Embark on a journey through diverse floors and biomes, vanquish formidable foes, and level up to acquire new spells. As you delve deeper, you'll be able to loot the finest equipment to aid in your adventure.
